cards.title: Cause for Celebration
cards.instruction: Interpret every development as a reason to celebrate. Find victory in setbacks, warnings, and bad news.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The power's out! Our candle collection finally gets its premiere.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We don't own candles.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A shopping trip with a purpose!

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The shops have no power either.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. The whole town's joining in.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 turns lost power into a premiere, A3 missing candles into a purposeful outing, and A5 wider outage into communal participation.

responseLogic.evidence: No candles causes the shopping plan; closed powerless shops turn a household event into a town-wide celebration.

relationship.evidence: B supplies relevant practical corrections but makes no positive proposal of their own.

heightening.evidence: A5 expands who is supposedly celebrating because B expands the outage.

specificity.evidence: A1 names the power failure and intended candle use; the absent collection is immediately corrected.

brevityWit.evidence: The whole town joining uses B’s exact geographic expansion rather than a generic wonderful.

cards.title: Practical Realist
cards.instruction: Accept any unusual premise without debate. Focus immediately on schedules, costs, safety, and what must happen next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If the ceiling's talking, does it need a microphone for the meeting?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're not surprised the ceiling talks?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It only speaks in prophecy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Can it predict the parking bill?

cardFidelity.evidence: A accepts a talking ceiling and focuses on audibility and cost, as the card requires.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 asks whether A is surprised; A3 resumes the microphone concern without using new information. Prophecy prompts a parking question weakly tied to the meeting.

relationship.evidence: B mainly points out how unusual the premise is rather than helping arrange the event.

heightening.evidence: A5 adds a mundane concern but does not develop the meeting arrangements from B4.

specificity.evidence: Talking ceiling, balcony and meeting are easily understood through dialogue.

brevityWit.evidence: Predict the parking bill is compact but feels chosen as a mundane punchline.

beats.speaker: B
